$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/privacy-ops.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). Office only: apps/factory-api's privacy routes (B-W2b-405: data requests, erasure, retention) and its admin routes (B-W2b-415: the error queue, the scheduled jobs) write through command(), and the worker and scheduler in the tenant's system context (office role factory_runtime, RLS forced) write the sweeps, the failed messages and the job runs; who may read them is the API's permission (privacy and admin). The floor and portal/link sessions read and write nothing here. ErasureRecord is append-only (`@append-only`, scripts/factory/check-append-only.mjs): no update or delete grant, and the …_privacy_integration_w2b_guards triggers refuse UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE for every login. Data requests, retention rules and sweeps are kept, never deleted (the triggers). A failed message and a job run are deleted only by the retention sweep, and the triggers allow it only for a closed item 30 days after it closed and for a run 7 days after it finished. GATE-PRIVACY: a retention rule only reports until a person switches it on. Nothing here holds money. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

DataRequest.about: A person's request to see, erase or correct their data with its 30-day clock (PLT-202, PLT-203): the office records it, checks the identity, works on it and closes it (Admin › Privacy & notices › Data requests). Personal data: the request names the person by their record. Never deleted. Office only.

RetentionRule.about: How long each record type is kept and what happens then, with the legal reason (PLT-204): the office keeps the rules (Admin › Privacy & notices › Retention rules; shortening asks the Owner's fresh code), the sweep reads them. Switched off, never deleted. Office only.

RetentionSweep.about: One pass of the retention sweep over one rule (PLT-204): the nightly job or a person's sweep writes it RUNNING and finishes it once with its counts; the rules list shows the last one. Never deleted. Office only.

ErasureRecord.about: What was erased of one record and what stays and why (PLT-203): written by the erasure command of a data request or by an applying sweep, read with the request. Column names and the law only. Append-only. Office only.

IntegrationErrorItem.about: One failed message in or out (PLT-201): the worker writes it when an outbox event dies, a webhook fails or a call fails, an administrator retries or dismisses it (Admin › Connections & API › Error queue); the retention sweep removes a closed one 30 days after it closed. Office only.

CronRun.about: One run of a scheduled job for the tenant (PLT-221): the scheduler writes it RUNNING and finishes it once; administrators read the runs (Admin › Security & health › Jobs and integrations) and ask for a run now; the retention sweep removes a finished run 7 days after it finished at the earliest. Office only.
